name: std::indirectly_copyable

declarations.code:
template <class In, class Out>

concept indirectly_copyable =

    std::indirectly_readable<In> &&

    std::indirectly_writable<Out, std::iter_reference_t<In>>;

intro: The indirectly_copyable concept specifies the relationship between an indirectly_readable type and a type that is indirectly_writable. The indirectly_writable type must be able to directly copy the object that the indirectly_readable type references.

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: An int pointer iterates over {3, 7} and satisfies indirectly_copyable.
